newsitem.title: USA: U.S. COTTON WEEKLY EXPORT SALES HIGHLIGHTS--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. COTTON WEEKLY EXPORT SALES HIGHLIGHTS--USDA.

text.p: USDA cotton export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net Upland sales for the 1997/98 marketing year totaled 177,300 running bales (RB). The major buyers were Venezuela (44,200 RB), Brazil (35,600 RB), Mexico (30,400 MT), and Japan (16,600 RB).
Outstanding sales of 691,700 RB on July 31 (the end of the 1996/97 MY) were carried forward to 1997/98.
Final shipments of 114,400 RB brought accumulated exports for 1996/97 to 6,259,900 RB--10 percent less than the previous year's total of 6,991,300 RB.
Total shipments of American Pima of 448,000 RB exceeded the previous year's total of 285,400 RB by 57 percent.
Current outstanding sales for 1997/98 delivery total 235,000 RB, including carry-over sales of 40,700 RB.
